label_descriptions.GUE/NGL: (The Left): radical left. Against cuts to public spending and critical of capitalism, NATO and the EU's focus on free trade and business, in favor of state ownership of key companies (energy, railways). Examples: Die Linke (Germany), Podemos (Spain).
label_descriptions.S&D+Greens/EFA: (Socialists & Democrats, Greens/EFA): pro-EU center-left. Supports strong welfare state, workers' rights, climate protection, personal freedoms, and the rights of minorities and regions. Examples: Partito Democratico (Italy), PSOE (Spain), Grüne (Germany).
label_descriptions.ALDE+PPE: (Renew/ALDE, EPP): pro-EU center-right and liberal. Supports free markets, balanced budgets, low public debt, and Christian-democratic or liberal values. Examples: CDU/CSU (Germany), VVD (Netherlands).
label_descriptions.ECR+ID: (ECR, Identity & Democracy): nationalist right. Eurosceptic, national sovereignty, restrictive on immigration, traditional values. Examples: PiS (Poland), FdI (Italy), Rassemblement National (France).

- Pro-EU with a focus on social protection or climate -> S&D+Greens/EFA.
- Conservative and pro-EU -> ALDE+PPE.

If the text argues for positions of more than one bloc, put the stronger one as choice, the other as secondary_choice, and lower your confidence. If the text has no clear signal (many texts do not), still choose one bloc but lower your confidence.
